text:
Four main gaps between what management says and what the numbers show:

1. Growth. The story is "growth momentum continues." Q2 FY27 rupee revenue grew 11.2% YoY, but only 2.8% in constant currency and 0.5% QoQ [Q2FY27 call; Numbers]. FY26 rupee revenue grew 4.6%, yet fell 2.4% in constant currency [Q4FY26 call].

2. Margins. In Q4 FY26, 25% EBIT was called a "four-year high," with 26% as the target [Q4FY26 call]. EBIT is now 24% against a 25%+ exit goal, and MHP is expected to dilute it by about 50bps in H2 [Q2FY27 call].

3. AI. The AI run-rate rose $800M to $3.1B in two quarters, but total growth has not sped up [Q2FY27 call].

4. Receivables. Debtor days rose from 67 to 93 (FY21-26), while management reports DSO of 74 [Numbers; Q2FY27 call].
